info.title: PostDelegate Public API
info.description:
REST API for PostDelegate, a social media scheduler by Nasida Apps LLC. List channels, upload media and create, read and delete posts.

## Authentication
Send your workspace API key in the `Authorization` header as the bare key, with no `Bearer` prefix:

```
Authorization: YOUR_API_KEY
```

Get the key in the app under Settings > Agents / Dev (plans that include the API).

## Rate limits
POST /posts is limited to 30 requests per hour per workspace. Batch several channels into one request.

## Terminology
The app says channel; the API says integration.

Docs: https://postdelegate.com/docs/api

delete.description: Delete a post by its ID. The API will look up the post and delete all posts in the same group.
Delete all posts in a group by the group identifier.

get.description:
When a post has been published but the platform did not return a usable post ID (the `releaseId` is set to `"missing"`), this endpoint fetches recent content from the provider so you can match and connect the correct one to the post.

The provider must implement the optional `missing` method. If the provider does not support it, an empty array is returned.

200.description: List of recent content items from the provider

put.description:
Updates the `releaseId` of a post that currently has its release ID set to `"missing"`. This connects the post to its actual published content on the platform, enabling analytics and statistics tracking.

Typically used after calling the **Get Missing Content** endpoint to retrieve the list of available content items.

releaseId.description: The platform-specific content ID to connect to this post

put.description:
Moves a post between `draft` and `schedule` state.

- `schedule` → sets the post state to `QUEUE` and (re)starts the publishing workflow so it will be published at its stored date.
- `draft` → sets the post state to `DRAFT` and terminates any currently running publishing workflow for the post, so it will not be published.

The post keeps its stored date; only the state (and the workflow) changes.

400.description: Invalid status or post not found

put.description: Merges the given keys into the post's existing provider settings. Only the keys you pass are changed; content and publish date are untouched, so a running publishing workflow is not restarted. The merged settings are re-validated. Works only on not-yet-published posts (scheduled or draft).

settings.description: Provider settings to merge into the post's existing settings. Only the keys you pass are changed; everything else stays. Keys depend on the channel's platform.

400.description: The id belongs to a comment (pass the root post id), the post is already published or its publish time passed, or the merged settings failed validation

post.description: Upload a media file using multipart form data.

adjust.description: Adjust the file to the platforms' limits after the upload: videos are scaled to a 1080 px short side (long side at most 1920 px) and re-encoded to H.264 MP4 with AAC audio, images larger than that are scaled down. Runs in the background, poll GET /media/{id}/status for the result. Defaults to false.

post.description: Upload a file from an existing URL.

url.description: URL of the file to upload

adjust.description: Adjust the file to the platforms' limits after the upload: videos are scaled to a 1080 px short side (long side at most 1920 px) and re-encoded to H.264 MP4 with AAC audio, images larger than that are scaled down. Runs in the background, poll GET /media/{id}/status for the result. Defaults to false.

get.description: Check whether a file uploaded with adjust set to true finished adjusting. A failed adjustment returns status "ready" with a warning: the original file was kept and is used for publishing.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The media id returned by the upload

warning.description: Present when the adjustment failed and the original file was kept

error.description: Present with status "failed", only when the adjustment failed and the original file's format cannot be published as is

get.description: List the media files already uploaded to your organization's media library, newest first, 18 per page.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive filter on the original file name.

get.description: Lists the templates with the JSON schema of the `spec` each one takes. New templates appear here by themselves, so read the schema instead of hard-coding it.

post.description: Makes a Studio project from a template and a spec and starts rendering it. Limited to 30 requests per workspace per hour, refused requests included. Poll GET /studio/renders/{id} until the status is completed, failed or cancelled.

400.description: Unknown template, a spec that does not follow the schema, a media that is not in the media library or not ready, or a video longer than 90 seconds

406.description: Studio needs an active plan, or the trial videos are used

429.description: Too many requests this hour, 3 videos already waiting, or the daily limit is reached

get.description: Returns a render. On completed, mediaId and path are the new video in the media library.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The render id returned by POST /studio/renders

404.description: Render not found, including renders of another workspace

post.description: Stops a render that is still waiting or rendering and returns it. A render that already ended is returned as it is.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The render id returned by POST /studio/renders

ApiKeyAuth.name: Authorization
ApiKeyAuth.description: Your PostDelegate workspace API key, or an OAuth app access token (starts with pos_), as the bare value with no Bearer prefix

path.description: Public file URL, usable as a post attachment

status.description: "processing" while an upload with adjust set to true is being adjusted, otherwise "ready"

settings.description: The post's current provider-specific settings (the same shape used when creating the post). Keys depend on the channel's platform.

error.description: For posts in the ERROR state, the error message reported by the platform when it rejected the post (the same message shown in the calendar tooltip). `null` when the post did not fail or no platform message is available.
error.example: Account banned from posting, please check TikTok account status

date.description: Publish date in UTC ISO format

thumbnailTimestamp.description: Milliseconds into the video to use as the cover/thumbnail frame. Supported by Instagram, Instagram Standalone, TikTok Business, and TikTok (Direct Post only, not the UPLOAD/inbox flow); other providers ignore it. For TikTok, in our testing the cover was applied only to public posts (privacy_level PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE).

who_can_reply_post.description: Who can reply to the post

__type.description: Use 'linkedin' for profiles, 'linkedin-page' for company pages

post_as_images_carousel.description: Display multiple images as a carousel

is_trial_reel.description: Whether to post as a trial reel

title.description: Used as the title of the post. The only setting TikTok keeps when content_posting_method=UPLOAD.

privacy_level.description: Applied only when content_posting_method=DIRECT_POST. Ignored by TikTok on UPLOAD.

duet.description: Video posts only, and only when content_posting_method=DIRECT_POST. TikTok has no duet setting for photo posts.

stitch.description: Video posts only, and only when content_posting_method=DIRECT_POST. TikTok has no stitch setting for photo posts.

comment.description: Applied only when content_posting_method=DIRECT_POST. Ignored by TikTok on UPLOAD.

autoAddMusic.description: Photo posts only, and only when content_posting_method=DIRECT_POST. Ignored by TikTok on UPLOAD.

brand_content_toggle.description: Applied only when content_posting_method=DIRECT_POST. Ignored by TikTok on UPLOAD.

brand_organic_toggle.description: Applied only when content_posting_method=DIRECT_POST. Ignored by TikTok on UPLOAD.

video_made_with_ai.description: Labels the post as AI generated. Video posts only, and only when content_posting_method=DIRECT_POST. TikTok has no AI-generated label for photo posts, and discards it on UPLOAD.

content_posting_method.description: Required. Use "DIRECT_POST" to actually publish the post to TikTok. "UPLOAD" does NOT publish: it only sends the media to the user's TikTok app inbox, where they must manually finish and publish it within 24 hours or it is discarded. Only use "UPLOAD" when the user explicitly asks to review or edit the post inside the TikTok app before publishing. "UPLOAD" also makes TikTok ignore every other setting in this object except the title.

GmbSettings.title: Google Business Profile
GmbSettings.description: Google Business Profile post settings. A post is up to 1,500 characters with one optional image. Videos are not supported. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; event dates default to the day the post is published, and event times are HH:mm. The CALL button dials the phone number on the Business Profile and takes no URL.

callToActionUrl.description: URL for CTA (required if callToActionType is set, except NONE and CALL, which dials the phone number of the profile)

eventTitle.description: Event or offer title (required for EVENT and OFFER types)

eventStartDate.description: Event or offer start date (required for OFFER type)

eventEndDate.description: Event or offer end date (required for OFFER type)

url.description: Optional link URL to include in the post

EmptySettings.title: Other Platforms (Threads, Mastodon, Bluesky, etc.)
EmptySettings.description: For platforms that don't require additional settings

hasMore.description: Whether there are more pages available

link.description: Optional link associated with the notification

url.description: Thumbnail or preview URL for the content

percentageChange.description: Percentage change over the selected period

captions.description: The template shows captions: send what is said in `captions.script`

schema.description: JSON schema of the `spec` a render of this template takes

name.description: Name of the project in Studio, the template's title by default

spec.description: Follows the template's `schema`. Media are ids from your own media library, never URLs

mediaId.description: The new video in the media library, once completed
